title: I’ve taken on a boss fight for the first time what do you think?
author: Background_Ranger667

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: the boss dead is the best for me :D

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body: I used the exact same asset pack for my first 3d game , loved how cute the characters are , but the poly count is quite high :(

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: I haven't noticed any performance issues yet, but I love this pack.

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body:
Nice!   Yea I just noticed it because I build for browser , so loading them in was quite taxing 

But keep up the work, looks good

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Ah, that makes total sense for a browser game where load times and bundle sizes matter a lot! Thanks for the kind words, I really appreciate it!

comments.author: cheyumaama
comments.body: Doesn't look smooth and the graphics and UI need to be better too

replies.author: cheyumaama
replies.body: Hit effects on the body's physics need to be implemented as well

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Chill the game is build in 5 hours dafuq

replies.author: tworc2
replies.body: You literally asked what people think

replies.author: KorsAirPT
replies.body: no one cares how many hours it took and I believe you posted here for feedback right?

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: True! My bad, got a bit defensive there. Thanks for the feedback on the movement and physics, I'll definitely keep working on it.

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Haha, yeah, I could definitely use some optimal recovery right now! Thanks!

comments.author: DisastrousDaikon8758
comments.body:
can you just make it already not post every new thing each day.. getting worse than that fishing game..

make it for you bro.

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Haha, fair critique! But hey, sharing daily progress keeps me motivated. I'll try not to flood the feed too much from now on though

comments.author: ImpressGlittering112
comments.body: really good animations! visual cues are great, maybe a more integrated indicator for boss rushing into player instead of a red stripe. But that's just design preference \^\^ keep it up

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Thank you so much! I'm really glad you like the animations and cues. That's a great point about the red stripe indicator I'll definitely look into making it blend into the environment or boss design a bit more naturally. Appreciate the feedback and the kind words!
